result.title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models
result.summary: Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff's delta up to 0.867 beyond the budget). Both results follow if agreement, and not the normalisation itself, is what keeps depth reusable. The damage sits in the readout together with the last layer of the block: in the models trained from scratch, refitting the head over the frozen modified loop recovers a third of the lost accuracy and plateaus, while refitting the last block layer with it recovers all of it. Finally, comparing looped with stacked depth at an equal inference loop count is confounded by unequal overshoot of the trained budget; at matched overshoot the advantage of looping vanishes on one task and shrinks on the other.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验 looped language model 的深度可复用性究竟依赖循环步间状态归一化，还是训练与推理所用循环方式的一致性；通过移除 Ouro 权重的 loop-boundary normalisation、从头训练小模型，并重拟合读出层与末层来定位失效来源。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非多模态工作，但其对循环深度外推、状态范数增长及训练—推理 loop agreement 的拆解，可供核查 latent 循环推理的状态稳定性与长度泛化；读出层单独重拟合仅部分恢复，也可能提示 latent 内容使用与贡献分配问题。
